prose.text: These are the gates for a dependency bump. The bump's own subject comes first: the resolution probe, the advisory-DB currency control, `cargo audit`, the two `cargo deny` invocations kept separate (security rule 2026-08-17), the Cranelift assertion and the no-ignore and lockfile-family guards. Then the plugins regression net, the standard test-plan §3 set in its order (capability-drift before the default-features workspace nextest; the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen as the last cargo-adjacent step; the base-identity bindings close, since no procedure is added), and the operator pass.

Absences, each with its reason: - No `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched, so the webview gates are absent. - No boot-path file is touched (`main.rs`, `observability.rs`, `crates/ui-bridge/src/`, `tauri.conf.json`, `capabilities/*.json`; the scope-guard entry proves it), so the boot smoke does not bind (test-plan §3 Boot-smoke gate). - There is no live leg and no self-verify (no UI change). - `cargo auditable build --workspace --release` is not listed locally because `cargo auditable` is not installed on this host. The CI `supply-chain` job runs it, and the operator CI read asserts that job green.

`cargo xtask pre-push:linux` cannot evaluate on the Linux dev host, because it drives every stage through `wsl.exe` (`xtask/src/pre_push.rs:23`). By founder ruling 2026-10-04 (given live at this plan's review), its six stages run NATIVELY by hand before the push, recorded as the same deviation as 2026-10-02-incident-events-readable-through-mcp (`evidence/operator-pass.md`, Gate 18). They are the six `operator` entries after hygiene, in `Stage::ALL` order: script-modes, source-lint, npm, clippy, test, ci-gates. Each runs in the stage isolation of `Linux::cmd`: `env -i` with only HOME, a Linux PATH and `ANDROMEDA_PULSE_DATA_DIR=target/pre-push/data`, the WSL form's own data path, which is gitignored. The first failing stage stops the run and the push; the operator re-runs them before every fix push. Two differences from the WSL form, as before: the stages run in the working tree rather than a synced clone, and they share this host's `target/` and `~/.cache`. Porting the verb is the route entry "pre-push:linux runs natively on Linux". The stage readings go into `evidence/operator-pass.md`.

`evidence/advisory-record.md` and `evidence/lockfile-delta.md`, which a criterion and Step 5 name, have no producing entry by construction. /implement writes them from the recorded outputs of the `cargo audit`, `cargo deny check advisories` and lockfile-guard entries above (and from the chunk base's readings in research.md §Measured). They are records of listed gates, not runtime artifacts a leg emits.
